map.测距仪斜距 → 水平距离 使用指南: Rangefinder Slope Distance to Horizontal Distance User Guide
map.输入测距仪测得的斜距 L 与竖直角 α，按 D=L·cosα 将斜距归算为水平距: Enter the slope distance L measured by a rangefinder and the vertical angle alpha, and reduce the slope distance to a horizontal distance as D = L*cos(alpha); used to convert slope distances into horizontal distances for total station and rangefinder observations.
map.D = L·cos(α)，α 为竖直角。: D = L*cos(alpha), where alpha is the vertical angle.
map.由坐标差算水平距。: Compute the horizontal distance from coordinate differences.
map.：ΔN=60、ΔE=80 → 水平距=√(60²+80²)=100m。: : Delta N = 60, Delta E = 80 -> horizontal distance = sqrt(60^2 + 80^2) = 100 m.
map.：界址/边线按水平距钉桩，坡地用斜距须先改化到水平。: : Boundary and edge lines are staked out by horizontal distance, so a slope distance on sloping ground must first be reduced to horizontal.
map.由斜距与垂直角求水平距: Horizontal distance from slope distance and vertical angle
map.由半径与转角求中弦垂距: Mid-ordinate from the radius and the deflection angle
map.由两端与中截面面积求棱台体积: Volume of a prismoid from the two end areas and the mid-section area
map.水平距=投影距？: Is the horizontal distance the projected distance?
map.是，忽略高程的平面距离，测量平距即此。: Yes, it is the planar distance ignoring elevation; the horizontal distance measured is exactly this.
map.斜距含高差，水平距=斜距×sin(天顶距)，坡越大差越多。: The slope distance includes the height difference; horizontal distance = slope distance x sin(zenith distance), and the steeper the slope, the bigger the difference.
